correctness.rationale: Upper bound gamma<=floor((n+2)/4) is explicitly credited to Campos-Wakabayashi (n+n2)/4 with n2=2, not claimed as new; existence of that theorem confirmed via Crossref record (DOI 10.1016/j.dam.2012.08.023, DAM 161(3):330-335) and independent secondary statement in Borg-Kaemawichanurat arXiv:2002.06014 that gamma<=(n+n2)/4 was obtained by Campos-Wakabayashi and independently Tokunaga. Sharpness/lower bound is proved by explicit witnesses: auditor independently re-ran exact solvers on all 21 shipped extremals (n=10..30) and confirmed each is a valid maximal outerplanar striped graph (n-3 non-crossing diagonals, exactly two degree-2 vertices) with gamma_exact==floor((n+2)/4); for n<=20 extremals additionally confirmed gamma_bruteforce==gamma_exact. Exact-maxima claim M(n)=floor((n+2)/4) for 10<=n<=20 proved by complete fixed-ear peel-word enumeration (2^(n-4) words) quotiented by dihedral canonical signatures: auditor recomputed full unlabelled censuses for n=10..20 and reproduced DRAFT/table10_18.json exactly (e.g. n=10:20 reps dist {1:1,2:16,3:3} max 3; n=16:1056 reps max 4; n=17:2080 reps max 4; n=18:4160 reps max 5; n=19:8256 reps max 5; n=20:16512 reps max 5) with B&B-vs-brute agreement on all reps for n<=12 and spot/full agreement to n=20. For 21<=n<=30 M(n) is pinned by cited ceiling plus certified attaining witness, which is logically sufficient. Residue arithmetic floor((n-s+2)/4)+1<=floor((n+2)/4) for n>=10 s=4,5 verified. End-block lemma honestly flagged as incomplete induction data (46/48 configs plus 4-block fallback) and NOT used for the ceiling; auditor re-ran the abstract check (16/16 four-prefixes pass, 30/32 five-prefixes pass, fails exactly LLLLR/RRRRL with 4-block fallback Q empty). No false proof claim remains. Boundary cases n=6..9 also satisfy bound (auditor: maxima 2,2,2,2 vs bounds 2,2,2,2). Caro-Wei never binds on extremals (auditor spot-checked exact Fraction values, e.g. n=10 ~2.41<3, n=18 ~4.10<5, n=30 ~6.62<8). Pilot errors (512 words at n=12, 256 extremals at n=18, zigzag attains) explicitly corrected in DRAFT and confirmed falsified (zigzag gamma 3,4,5,6 at N=14,18,22,26 vs targets 4,5,6,7 per DRAFT diag; auditor confirmed census zigzag column).

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: (1) Campos-Wakabayashi 2013 / Tokunaga 2013 prove the numerical inequality gamma<=(n+n2)/4, hence (n+2)/4 for n2=2, but DRAFT claims no originality for the inequality and no source found states sharpness for EVERY n in the striped class, exact M(n) sequence, full dihedral-quotiented distributions, extremal counts, or peel-word family. Borg-Kaemawichanurat arXiv:2002.06014 confirms the inequality and says 'bounds are sharp' in the general (n,n2) sense, not per-n striped classification. (2) Zhuang arXiv:2107.02796 is the unique arXiv hit for 'striped maximal outerplanar' and treats DOUBLE domination (floor(2n/3), min(floor((n+t)/2),n-t)), not standard gamma. (3) Alvarado-Dantas-Rautenbach arXiv:1511.08713 treats component-constrained domination generalizing n/3, not striped exact maxima. (4) Borg-Kaemawichanurat arXiv:1903.12292 treats 1-isolation iota_1 (n/5, (n+n2)/6), different objective. (5) Liu note and other outerplanar domination papers target the general class. arXiv full-text searches for 'striped maximal outerplanar', 'outerplanar snake domination', 'linear 2-tree domination' return zero standard-domination striped results; Crossref query for striped maximal outerplanar domination returns only double/total/secure variants. Hence the combination — complete striped census to n=20, per-n sharpness to n=30 via explicit comb family LRLLL(RLLL)*, falsification of zigzag, extremal counts/degree profiles/gap tables — is not definitionally anticipated. DRAFT's honesty about the corollary risk strengthens the claim.

value.rationale: Not a textbook restatement (inequality itself disclaimed), not a mere parameter substitution (setting n2=2 alone gives only the ceiling; the contribution is per-n sharpness, complete distributions, and extremal geometry), not a tiny unmotivated gain (ceiling beats floor(n/3) by 1-2 across the window, ~n/12 asymptotically, e.g. 10 vs 8 at n=30, with quantified Caro-Wei gaps >=0.5; motivation is guard over-provisioning on linear stacked-polygon chains), and not an unexplained enumeration (distributions plus structural discovery: alternating zigzag does NOT attain the bound while 3+1-periodic comb does, with comb-like hub degree sequences vs flat zigzag profile; plus 48-configuration end-block data toward a citation-free induction). The exact table (M(n)=floor((n+2)/4) for 10<=n<=20 with full gamma distributions and labelled/unlabelled extremal counts) plus 21 machine-checkable extremal adjacency lists pinning M(n) for 21<=n<=30 is a checkable, citable dataset independently worth finding later as the striped reference point versus the loose n/3 ceiling.
